name: Mary Astell
shortBio: English philosopher and pioneer of feminist political and educational theory; utilized Cartesian rationalism to argue for women's intellectual equality, moral autonomy, and institutional self-determination.
centralQuestion: If all men are born free, how is it that all women are born slaves; and how does Cartesian rational self-mastery enable women's intellectual and spiritual liberation?

keyWorks.title: A Serious Proposal to the Ladies
keyWorks.description: Revolutionary call for establishing women's secular academic communities dedicated to philosophical study and moral self-perfection.

keyWorks.title: Some Reflections upon Marriage
keyWorks.description: Philosophical critique of marital subjugation, exposing the contradiction between political anti-tyrannical theory and domestic patriarchy.
